cand.title: AACR Special Conference in Cancer Research: Cancer Evolution
cand.excerpt: AACR publishes the 2027 special conference dates and Hilton Toronto venue.
cand.selectionWhy: Ledger shows competitor venue/hotel: Hilton Toronto

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Lauren Santarone, Senior Director of Meetings, is the strongest operational entry point: a contemporaneous AACR conference prospectus explicitly lists her under “Meeting and Housing Management.” Tammy Berger, CEM, Senior Director, Exhibits, is a secondary logistics/exhibitor coordination contact in the same prospectus, not a verified hotel buyer. Both roles are verified at AACR, but neither person is explicitly assigned to Cancer Evolution 2027 in the reviewed material and individual contracting authority is unverified. Scientific cochairs Karen E. de Visser, Trevor A. Graham and Stefani Spranger are program leadership, not evidenced lodging procurement contacts.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for June 21–23, 2027, Hilton Toronto, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. These are activity dates, corroborated by the daily program, not webpage publication dates. The program states: “this meeting will take place as an in-person event in Toronto and will not live-stream content for virtual participation.” Within the requested horizon. No later Cancer Evolution edition was identified in the official material reviewed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu’s 157 guestrooms and approximately 240-theatre largest room support a limited delegate/speaker/VIP lodging or small side-meeting proposition, not an assumed full-conference relocation. This is a downtown scientific hotel conference, so an urban hotel is more relevant than resort positioning. AACR describes Special Conferences generally as 150–400 attendees; that is portfolio context, NOT an attendance estimate for Cancer Evolution 2027. No event-specific attendance, peak rooms or room-night total was found. The upper end of that generic range would exceed the supplied ballroom theatre capacity. Do not convert the generic range into room demand. Restaurant/lounge and catering capability must be verified before proposing catered receptions.
findings.venueCommitments: Hilton Toronto is the sole edition-specific hotel venue identified. AACR explicitly publishes “June 21-23, 2027 Hilton Toronto Toronto, Ontario, Canada.” Hilton gives its address as 145 Richmond Street West and describes its location as downtown Toronto: Toronto proper, not a suburban or resort location and not an MTCC/Exhibition Place venue. Commitment type: publicly designated conference venue at a competing hotel. A signed contract, exclusivity provisions and guestroom commitment were not published in the reviewed evidence.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified related CEWG special conferences: December 3–6, 2023, Westin Copley Place, Boston, Massachusetts, under Translating Cancer Evolution and Data Science: The Next Frontier; December 4–6, 2025, The Clyde Hotel, Albuquerque, New Mexico, under Cancer Evolution: The Dynamics of Progression and Persistence; announced June 21–23, 2027, Hilton Toronto. This documents changing destinations, not a fixed rotation policy. The 2021 CEWG announcement proposed an “annual Cancer Evolution Special Conference,” but that intention does not verify annual delivery. Toronto is verified for 2027 only; no repeated Toronto cycle or subsequent Toronto edition was found.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Conference hotel venue: Hilton Toronto only. Guestroom sourcing pathway remains unknown: no edition-specific official housing bureau, published accommodation block, group rate, booking code, cutoff, reservation link, overflow hotel or open RFP was located. The venue quote is “June 21-23, 2027 Hilton Toronto Toronto, Ontario, Canada”; it proves the venue designation, not a room block. The event RFI asks people to be “notified when abstract submission and registration are available”; it is an attendee notification form, not a procurement RFI. AACR’s general FAQ routes meeting/registration and accommodation questions to its Meetings Department; this is an enquiry route, not an edition-specific housing commitment. Do not transfer housing arrangements from AACR Annual Meetings or other conferences to this edition.
findings.organizationStructure: AACR is the event organizer, a research membership association and 501(c)(3) public charity, not a corporate event agency. The event is in association with its Cancer Evolution Working Group. Hilton Toronto is the venue, not the event owner. AACR publishes an internal Meetings and Exhibits function whose remit includes site selection, hotel negotiation and housing; no edition-specific external PCO, DMC or housing bureau was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hilton Toronto has the documented venue incumbency and the convenience advantage of accommodation at the meeting hotel (commercial inference, not proof of a block). No other Toronto hotel was identified as committed for this edition. There is no sourced evidence that Hilton is sold out, constrained, releasing overflow or seeking another hotel. No rate, inventory allocation, room-night production, exclusivity or attendee hotel split is published in the reviewed evidence.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Lauren Santarone first, citing the June 21–23, 2027 Hilton Toronto conference, and request the assigned Cancer Evolution meetings/housing lead. Ask whether an official guestroom block exists, whether any approved off-site lodging or VIP/speaker needs remain, and whether ancillary meetings are allowed. Only then offer a modest block/side-meeting option subject to availability and verified catering. Use Tammy Berger only for appropriate exhibits/logistics routing, not as presumed accommodation decision-maker. Separately ask when later Cancer Evolution destinations and hotel sourcing will be evaluated; request consideration for a future Toronto requirement, without asserting a scheduled return.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the announced 2027 edition, the core venue is already designated elsewhere. No verified open accommodation procurement route exists in the reviewed material. A realistic but unverified Radisson role is a small off-site speaker/delegate/VIP block or ancillary meeting, only if AACR confirms unmet need and permits off-site arrangements. It is not confirmed overflow business, not an MTCC convention housing lead and not a replacement-venue opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the documented moves from Boston to Albuquerque to Toronto justify cultivating AACR as a multi-destination account before later sourcing decisions. They do not establish another Toronto edition, an annual/biennial schedule, an open future bid or suitability for hosting the entire event. Future competitive capture should be conditional on a Toronto return and actual room, plenary, poster and catering requirements fitting the hotel.
